_note: The six entries of the first edition. Each entry is a whole agent system: model + harness. Colours (Chi 11-09): close to each official brand colour, adjusted for distinctness; the renderers dress each model in it. colour = light theme; colour_dark = the dark-theme variant where the brand colour would vanish (Kimi black -> light silver); outline_light = thin dark outline on swatches / dots / bars in the light theme (GLM yellow on white). harness / effort / entry: the official release run's entrant definitions (evalops-r1107/entries/<entrant>.json: harness.name, model.params.reasoning_effort, entry_id).
